# Broono Demo Video Script

## Goal

Show the problem, the product, and the offer in under 45 seconds.

## Format

- Length: 35–45 seconds
- Aspect ratio: 9:16 for Reels / Shorts / TikTok
- Secondary export: 1:1 for LinkedIn feed
- CTA: Join waitlist — first 100 get free lifetime access

## Storyboard

### Scene 1 — Hook (0–5s)
**Visual:** Fast cuts of cluttered notes, scale anxiety, medication reminders, and generic health apps.

**On-screen text:**
"GLP-1 progress is hard to manage when everything lives in different places."

**Voiceover:**
"If you're on a GLP-1 journey, tracking progress should feel calm — not chaotic."

### Scene 2 — Brand + Promise (5–10s)
**Visual:** Broono logo, clean interface reveal, dashboard opening.

**On-screen text:**
"Meet Broono. Your private GLP-1 companion."

**Voiceover:**
"Broono is a private, mobile-first companion built for people using GLP-1 medications."

### Scene 3 — Core workflow (10–20s)
**Visual:** Show weight logging, injection logging, water/protein tracking, journal entry.

**On-screen text:**
- Track weight
- Log injections
- Monitor habits
- Journal your journey

**Voiceover:**
"Track your weight, log injections, stay on top of hydration and protein, and keep your health journey in one place."

### Scene 4 — Privacy differentiator (20–28s)
**Visual:** Shield icon, device-only copy, simple privacy panel.

**On-screen text:**
"Your health data stays on your device."

**Voiceover:**
"Your personal health logs stay on your device, so you stay in control."

### Scene 5 — Momentum + premium outcome (28–36s)
**Visual:** Progress graph, journal history, export summary mockup, paywall teaser.

**On-screen text:**
"Built to help you stay consistent — and see progress."

**Voiceover:**
"Broono helps turn scattered habits into visible momentum, with premium tools for deeper insights and review-ready summaries."

### Scene 6 — Waitlist CTA (36–45s)
**Visual:** Waitlist page + founder face cam or logo lockup.

**On-screen text:**
"Android launch first. iPhone next. First 100 waitlist members get free lifetime access."

**Voiceover:**
"We're launching on Android first. Join the waitlist now — the first 100 people get free lifetime access."

## Editing Notes

- Use crisp zoom-ins and 0.5x–0.75x speed ramps.
- Keep captions burned in for silent viewing.
- Use one calm electronic / wellness-style music bed.
- End with the waitlist URL in large text.

## CTA Variants

- Join the waitlist
- Claim your lifetime spot
- Be one of the first 100
